scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.test:ci: node scripts/run-isolated-tests.mjs test/unit .test.mjs security key-scope panel-acl api-channel-routing convert-stream pool-scheduler tenant-billing rate-limit-service errors-map proxy-http-scheme cache-prefix request-body-context outbound-log-envelope
scripts.test:go: cd worker && go test -race ./... && cd ../protofront && go test -race ./...
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.build:worker: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-worker ./cmd/kin-worker
scripts.build:egress: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-egress ./cmd/kin-egress
scripts.build:gate: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-slot-gate ./cmd/kin-slot-gate
scripts.build:proto-front: mkdir -p bin && cd protofront && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-proto-front ./cmd/kin-proto-front
scripts.build:scheduler: mkdir -p bin && cd scheduler && cargo build --release --locked --bin kin-scheduler && cp "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/release/kin-scheduler" ../bin/kin-scheduler.new && chmod 755 ../bin/kin-scheduler.new && mv -f ../bin/kin-scheduler.new ../bin/kin-scheduler
scripts.format: biome format --write && gofmt -w worker api-kernel redact protofront && pnpm -C web format
scripts.format:check: biome format && node scripts/check-gofmt.mjs && pnpm -C web format:check
